name: Lesson explainer for teachers
description: Bounded multi-agent: a coordinating agent prepares teaching material by delegating, at most twice, to an allowlisted explainer and a worked-example agent. A second teacher or school administrator approves the material before it is released.

steps.title: Prepare the explanation and a worked example
steps.instructions: You coordinate the preparation of teaching material for a Grade {{input.grade}} teacher in Papua New Guinea on the topic: {{input.topic}}. The material needs a clear explanation of the concept for students and one worked example. Choose the next action. Choose done only when both parts exist.
steps.delegate_prompt:
{{task}}

Topic: {{input.topic}}. Audience: Grade {{input.grade}} students in Papua New Guinea. Keep it under 300 words.
